title: PDV Phase 20 Khajiit lunar, focus, and road-home implementation costing
designRules: Moon phases add texture and small amplification; they must not become required scheduling chores.
Focused emphasis emerges from play and remains silent by default, not a formal patron-pick menu.
Khenarthi and Azurah are naturally easy hooks, so Baan Dar, Rajhin, and Alkosh need sharper proof.
Road homes should reward a circuit and belonging, not repeated camping at one bed.
ShadowDrift is a priced boundary state, not a free stealth reward.

notes: Focus requires a piety threshold and a meaningful lead; the mirror is CK-readable for verifier/status proof.
Broad lunar worship remains whole when no focus leads.
Werewolf strains form, vampire corrupts the Lattice, and ShadowDrift is a behavior boundary.
Requires a circuit; one repeated location alone must not count.
The first proof slice rejects immediate same-anchor repeats through PDV.Khajiit.RoadHome.LastAnchor.

diegeticTriggerMeaning: Moon cadence is texture and small amplification; focus emerges from lived behavior rather than manual patron selection.
Road homes, caravan kinship, and Baan Dar/Rajhin/Alkosh hooks give movement, trickery, legend, and order their own lanes.
feedbackSurface: Lunar posture, focus emergence, broad/focused Survey rows, and road-home notifications explain current belonging.
Quiet favor rows keep moon/road presence light; marked Baan Dar reversal carries rare story payoff.
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A Khajiit feels held by moon and road during ordinary travel, sleep, and community play without needing to schedule phases or farm crime.
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Before high-value focus favors, prove fallback moon cadence, focus readback, road-home anti-chore behavior, and negative cases for moon-sugar, fast travel, generic theft, and dragon spam.

Baan Dar, Rajhin, and Alkosh have distinct accepted and rejected surfaces

organicTriggerSurfaces.receiver: PDV_PlayerEvents alias (PO3 OnActorKilled, OnCombatStateChanged + 4s in-combat poll, OnItemAdded actor-source filter); no Story Manager quest needed because session state lives on the same alias.
records: PDV_FLST_AlkoshNamedDragons (6 Skyrim.esm named-dragon bases: MQ104Dragon, lvlMQ104Dragon, MQ106Dragon, MQResurrectDragon1/2/3; Alduin excluded as scripted death, DLC dragons excluded to keep masters Skyrim.esm-only)
PDV_FLST_RajhinNotableTargets (22 Skyrim.esm named bases: 9 jarls, Elenwen, Ondolemar, 6 court wizards, GeneralTullius, Maven, OlfridBattleBorn, Erikur, VittoriaVici)

hooks.contract: Combat session with 3+ player-attributed kills OR a victim 5+ levels above the player, AND health dipped below 50% during the session (adversity gate). One award per game-day plus shared daily decay.
hooks.rejected: Steamroll clears at high health, flee-without-kill survival, follower-carried fights.

hooks.contract: Health crossed 10% during the session and the player still won (1+ kill). Once per game-week; double emphasis weight plus the SIGNAL_BANDIT_ROAD marked beat; subsumes the outnumbered award when both qualify.
hooks.rejected: Fleeing after near-death without a kill.

hooks.contract: OnItemAdded from a living, non-teammate actor while sneaking and undetected; target in PDV_FLST_RajhinNotableTargets (always qualifies) or taken value >= 200 gold. Per-target 7-game-day cooldown plus shared daily decay.
hooks.rejected: Petty grabs from generic NPCs, corpse looting, detected attempts, teammate inventories.

hooks.contract: Player-attributed kill of a base in PDV_FLST_AlkoshNamedDragons; one-shot StorageUtil marker per base; awards focus signal plus SIGNAL_NAMED_DRAGON curated beat.
hooks.rejected: Resurrect-and-rekill of the same base, kills by followers.

hooks.contract: Player-attributed kill of any other ActorTypeDragon actor; emphasis-only nudge at 25% weight, max once per game-week, no piety pulse.
hooks.rejected: Repeated random-dragon farming inside the same week.

hooks.contract: Killing Paarthurnax routes the existing chaos-aid negative signal: slaying the reformed teacher of order is order-breaking in Alkosh's eyes.
hooks.rejected: No positive credit path exists for this kill.

hooks.contract: Dawn delta of the vanilla 'Words Of Power Learned' stat; matrix-scale emphasis nudge per new word, max 3 per dawn with remainder carried, baselined on first run so mid-save installs do not bulk-award.
hooks.rejected: No award at dawn without newly learned words; backlog from before install never scores.

deferredHooks: Khenarthi caravan-aid kill-proximity detection: deferred because Khenarthi is already the easiest focus and more feed would crowd the Baan Dar/Rajhin/Alkosh contrast lanes.
Rajhin botched-theft Crime Chain contrast (phase 1b): RouteKhajiitRajhinBotchedTheft exists and is unwired.

positive: fallback lunar cadence works even without reliable visible moon detection
focused emphasis emerges from play at threshold and can be explained in Survey/status
road-home circuit rewards varied anchors while keeping broad worship intact
Baan Dar, Rajhin, and Alkosh each have at least one sharp behavior-specific proof route
organic Baan Dar outnumbered/reversal, Rajhin elegant theft, and Alkosh named-dragon/word-drip detection fire in normal play without proof-cell activators
negative: moon-sugar use does not drive lunar devotion
fast travel or one-bed camping does not satisfy road-home cadence
generic crime or petty theft does not satisfy Rajhin
generic dragon kills do not repeatedly satisfy Alkosh
ordinary night stealth does not enter ShadowDrift
steamroll multi-kill fights at high health do not satisfy the Baan Dar adversity gate

firstImplementationSlice: Implement or verify fallback moon cadence and focused-emphasis readback before high-value focus favors.
Build road-home anchor/circuit behavior with one-bed and fast-travel negative cases.
Add one proof route each for Baan Dar, Rajhin, and Alkosh so Khenarthi/Azurah do not dominate.
Add ShadowDrift posture as a priced boundary with explicit rejection of ordinary night stealth.
